residual_definition: y minus all fitted slopes and fixed effects; independent native R stats::lm explicit indicators and Stata xtreg/predict,e. Residual diagnostics are descriptive and do not certify independence, model validity or causal identification.

row_transformations.two_way: All original 400 rows, entity and time effects
row_transformations.one_way: All 400 rows, entity effects only; no inferred temporal pairing
row_transformations.unbalanced: Retain source positions with (position+1) modulo 19 != 0; original order retained

did_reference: Existing panel_cluster/oracle.json: original Stata coefficients, SE, CIs and joint pre-lead F against full covariance, unchanged strict tolerances in test_panel_cluster_inference.py. Missing pre-period leads are unavailable, not non-rejection.
limits: No standalone serial-dependence test or cross-unit independence certificate. Entity/time labels define observed neighbors; gaps are not assumed to be one lag. HC without clustering is not certified for fixed-T FE; G<10 remains partial; G<30 caution has one source in checks/fit_checks.py. TWFE staggered interpretation restrictions require revision, not automatic estimator substitution.
no_m0_claim: No new panel/DID M0 trace or evaluated candidate score is invented; these are native numerical/delivery fixtures. The original six M0 failure recordings remain unchanged.
